summary: Describes EtherIP, an early and very lightweight tunneling protocol that carries Ethernet and IEEE 802.3 frames inside IP datagrams so non-IP traffic can cross an IP network. It is written for historical context for IP protocol number 97, and it does not protect against infinite loops.

eli5.summary: EtherIP puts a whole local-network message inside an ordinary internet package, like a letter inside a bigger envelope, so it can travel across the internet.

questions: how to tunnel ethernet over ip
